title: Eric Wang's secret UFO work at Kirtland, per his wife
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Steinman gets in touch with his wife uh Maria Wing and she says, "Oh yeah, he worked at Kirtland Air Force Base. He worked on some, you know, secret UFO related stuff."

plain: An engineer named Eric Henry Wang worked on secret UFO-related projects at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico in the 1950s or 60s, according to his wife, Maria Wang. Michels recounts that a UFO researcher named Bill Steinman got in touch with her and that she told him so; if true, it would place UFO work inside a real military base.
